themes.title: Economic Protectionism and Domestic Resource Deregulation
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist movements in the United States and Norway are mounting aggressive campaigns against rising energy costs and inflation by emphasizing domestic resource support and consumer tax relief. In Norway, the Progress Party is demanding emergency parliamentary action to cut fuel and CO2 taxes, while the Trump administration combines protectionist trade policies for domestic producers with direct economic dividend proposals.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump promises direct economic dividends to counter inflation while issuing executive support for ranchers and weighing import limits to shield domestic industries.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP demands an emergency parliamentary session to slash fuel taxes and reverse green tax hikes amid a growing consumer energy cost crisis.

themes.title: Right-Wing Parties Battle Electoral Rules and Funding Scrutiny
themes.blurb: Right-wing political organizations in both the US and Norway are navigating institutional resistance, legal scrutiny over campaign proposals, and local organizational friction ahead of elections. American conservative efforts face court rulings striking down postal voting restrictions and redistricting maps, while Norwegian party figures grapple with candidate controversies and local organizational challenges.
